goal: Preserve full archive while prioritizing high-significance memory fidelity and retrieval speed.
non_negotiables: No deletion of original memory records.
Immutable full archive tier remains complete.
Compression safety floor and recall guardrails remain active.

minimal_changes.name: Significance tagging at ingest
minimal_changes.change: Assign each engram a class: identity_anchor | family_core | strategic_learning | routine_operational.
minimal_changes.storage: Add significanceClass and significanceWeight in metadata.

minimal_changes.name: Tier routing
minimal_changes.change: Route memories to Tier1/Tier2/Tier3 pointers while storing full raw in Tier3.

minimal_changes.name: Compression profile by tier
minimal_changes.change: Use conservative profile for Tier1, standard MODEL_95 for Tier2, max compaction for Tier3 representations.

profiles.tier3: highest compaction representation + immutable raw backup

minimal_changes.name: Weighted retrieval index
minimal_changes.change: Rank retrieval by significanceWeight + recency + reference frequency before fallback to full archive scan.
minimal_changes.fallback: If retrieval confidence low, pull raw archive copy.

minimal_changes.name: Dual metrics pipeline
minimal_changes.change: Track both global compression and significance-aware metrics.

risk_controls: Feature flag gate all tiered behavior.
Canary on subset before global activation.
Automatic rollback to current MODEL_95 path on fidelity drift.
Retain existing checkpoint + chain integrity checks.
execution_plan: Finalize classifier calibration with Molly (split conversational routine vs relational anchor).
Implement metadata-only tagging first (no behavior change).
Enable weighted retrieval index with read-only mode.
Enable tier-specific compression profiles under flag.
Run A/B benchmark against current MODEL_95 and compare significance metrics.
